tagline: Commercial Roofing for Northeastern Pennsylvania Since 1993

team_members.name: Paul J. Eyerman, Jr.
team_members.bio: President of the company, with 35 years in the roofing industry. Paul is the person most Pinnacle customers deal with directly on a project.

team_members.name: Jerome F. Devlin
team_members.bio: Vice President of Operations, with 30 years in the roofing industry.

team_members.name: John Racht
team_members.bio: Growth in commercial construction around Scranton is what made the Dickson City satellite office necessary. With over 35 years in the roofing industry, John runs operations out of that facility.

team_members.name: Mariann Eyerman
team_members.bio: Mariann handles accounting, bookkeeping and the financial side of every Pinnacle project.

why_choose_us.title: Excalibur Award every year since 1994
why_choose_us.description: The Excalibur is given to the top roofing contractors in the United States — Versico's most prominent authorized contractors. Pinnacle has earned one every single year since 1994.

why_choose_us.title: Commercial only — not a shingle crew
why_choose_us.description: Flat and low-slope membrane, architectural metal and sheet metal is the whole business, not a sideline picked up between residential jobs.

why_choose_us.title: In NEPA since 1993
why_choose_us.description: Thirty-three years in the same market, from two staffed locations. When a warranty gets called in year twelve, we are still here to answer it.

why_choose_us.title: The buildings you already know
why_choose_us.description: Geisinger, Sanofi Pasteur, Tobyhanna Army Depot, Kalahari Resort, Wilkes University, Luzerne County Community College and the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton airport are all Pinnacle roofs.
